 BSF Tradesman Written Exam Date 2026 Out, Check CBT Schedule and Shift Timings
 The BSF Tradesman Written Exam Date 2026 has been announced for 2 December 2026. Candidates can check the complete CBT schedule, shift timings, important dates, e-admit card availability, and helpdesk contact details for the Constable Tradesman recruitment examination. 
 Supriya Shrivastava 13 Nov, 2026 Share
 Table of Content BSF Tradesman Written Exam Date 2026: Latest Update

 The Border Security Force (BSF) has officially announced the BSF Tradesman Written Exam Date 2026 for the Constable (Tradesmen) recruitment under BSF Exam-2024-25. According to the latest notification, the 2nd Phase Written Examination (Computer-Based Test) will be conducted on 2 December 2026 in three shifts across examination centres throughout India.
 Candidates who have qualified in the 1st Phase Physical Efficiency Test and Physical Standard Test (PET & PST) are eligible to appear for the CBT. The e-admit cards will be available for download from 17 November to 2 December 2026. Candidates can access their admit cards through the link sent to their registered email address and mobile number or by visiting the official BSF website at www.bsf.mha.gov.in .
 BSF Tradesman Written Exam Date 2026: Latest Update
 The Border Security Force has released the official examination schedule through notice number 9A/CT(TM)-2024-25/Pers(Rectt)/BSF/2026/9073, dated 10 November 2026.
 As per the notification, the 2nd Phase Written Examination will be conducted in online CBT mode on 2 December 2026. The examination will take place in three shifts, with each shift having a duration of 120 minutes.
 Candidates can also read about What is DWSAT? to understand its meaning, purpose, eligibility, and other important details.

 BSF Tradesman E-Admit Card 2026
 The BSF Tradesman e-admit card will be available from 17 November 2026. Candidates who have qualified in the PET and PST can download their e-admit cards through the link shared on their registered email address and mobile number or through the official BSF website.
 Candidates should keep their registered contact details accessible and download their admit cards before the examination date. The e-admit card will contain important information, including the examination date, shift timing and examination centre details.
 For any difficulty related to downloading the e-admit card, candidates can contact the BSF helpdesk at +91-9513251955 during the operational period.
 Candidates can also check the BSF HC RO RM Answer Key 2026 to download the answer key, verify their responses, and calculate their expected scores.
